visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with two pigtails and decorative hair clips stands on a wooden boardwalk, leaning against a dark brown metal railing. She wears a fuzzy brown sweater and light-colored jeans. In the background, a large multi-story resort building with tan walls and dark balconies is visible, surrounded by palm trees and lush greenery. (2) A second, smaller girl in a matching brown sweater walks along the boardwalk towards the first girl. The boardwalk is constructed from weathered wooden planks and is elevated above an animal habitat. (3) The camera provides a close-up of the girls looking through the railing bars. Below them, several meerkats are seen standing upright on tree stumps and scurrying over rocks in a sandy enclosure. (4) The scene transitions to a wider view of the animal enclosure featuring large grey rocks, a black pipe, and a pond where black swans swim. Lemurs with black-and-white ringed tails are seen resting on the pipe and rocks. (5) One girl tries to peek through the railing, placing her face between the metal bars. The other girl stands nearby, looking down at the animals with interest. (6) A large rhinoceros is shown from an overhead perspective, standing on a dirt patch near some rocks. It is light brown/grey and appears to be eating or sniffing the ground, moving its ears occasionally. (7) One girl is seated in a black stroller on the boardwalk, holding a small plastic-wrapped snack. She points towards the animals. (8) Close-up shots focus on the girls' reactions—smiles, pointing, and curious expressions—interspersed with shots of the rhinoceros and lemurs in their habitat. (9) The video ends with a pink screen featuring a cartoon illustration of the main girl and the branding text.
